resources.string: Singapore West 1-hr PM2.5 and 24-hr PSI from NEA

PSI West is installed.

To add the widget: long-press an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets, find PSI West, and drag it onto your screen.

It shows the West region 1-hr PM2.5 (colour-coded by NEA band) and 24-hr PSI, and refreshes every hour. Tap the widget to refresh it immediately.

Data: NEA via data.gov.sg.
